Path to the CSV file containing the reference regional emission totals used for regional emission rescaling. It may contain <date>; yearly inventories resolve it from the simulation date as YYYY and monthly inventories as YYYYMM. If <date> is omitted the configured file is used for all periods with a warning. If the resolved file does not exist, a <date>=default fallback file is used with a warning.
Indicates if derived regional rescaling factors must be applied to the entire inventory instead of only the emissions intersecting the configured regions.
Comma-separated region names to rescale, matching the Region column exactly. Empty, omitted or ALL selects all regions in the local totals CSV. ALL cannot be combined with region names.

Continue with a warning if selected regions are not completely inside the simulation domain. In-domain emissions are still scaled to the full regional local totals. Default False stops execution for incomplete domain coverage.

Path to the YAML proxy catalogue for conservative downscaling. Ordered proxies are applied by priority per source cell; cells without proxy coverage use area weights. Changing proxy definitions creates separate cached weight matrices and regridded emissions; changing proxy file contents requires clearing the corresponding auxiliary cache. Double proxies are not supported.
